scope.rationale: D-04 adds the approved typed Pivot/Unpivot provider overloads, the provider-local reference-identity rewriter and their SQL Server exact-SQL/guard tests. The compiled inputs are the public extension file, the internal provider rewriter, the typed SQL test class and the new shared six-provider capability case (a CommonTestSuite partial plus its fixture/hosts); the affected subset is the typed class in the SQL Server test project (compile gate: the SQL Server and integration test project builds). The adjudicated oracle repairs (typed-consumption remark, reflected cell type, split whole-source/no-value cases) touch only the same test file; no core file, dialect, builder, project/package file or existing test is touched.
scope.boundary: Single post-implementation boundary planned for D-07 (full per-project sweeps plus the six-provider container run, C11). D-04 records only its affected subset plus the solution-wide build gate as provenance. The container execution of the shared capability case is C07/D-05; a non-container SQLite-only smoke of that case is recorded as supporting evidence, not as the boundary.
